initialExam.title: MP Judicial Services 2026
initialExam.description: Recruitment of Civil Judges (Class II) in Madhya Pradesh through the MP Higher Judicial Service / Civil Judge Examination conducted by the Madhya Pradesh High Court.
initialExam.eligibility: LLB from recognized university + enrolled advocate
initialExam.qualifications: LLB degree + Advocate enrollment with Bar Council
initialExam.syllabus: Civil Law (CPC, Indian Contract Act, Transfer of Property Act, Specific Relief Act, Limitation Act, MP Accommodation Control Act, Family Law, Hindu Law, Muslim Law), Criminal Law (IPC, CrPC, Indian Evidence Act, NDPS Act, Juvenile Justice Act, Prevention of Corruption Act, POCSO Act), Constitutional & Administrative Law (Fundamental Rights, DPSP, Writs, Emergency Provisions, Tribunals, RTI Act), MP State Laws (MP Land Revenue Code, MP Panchayat Raj Avam Gram Swaraj Adhiniyam, MP Excise Act), Language Papers (Hindi and English proficiency, Essay Writing, Translation).
initialExam.examPattern: Prelims (Objective): Civil + Criminal + Constitutional Law + Hindi/English - 200 marks, 120 min. Mains: Paper I (Civil Law) 150 marks, Paper II (Criminal Law) 150 marks, Paper III (Constitutional Law) 100 marks, Paper IV (Hindi & English) 100 marks - 180/120 min. Viva Voce.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Preliminary Examination (Objective) → Mains Examination (Descriptive) → Viva Voce (Interview) → Document Verification → Medical Examination

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: OBC: 3 years, SC/ST: 5 years, PwD: 10 years

initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, Pension, Official Residence, Conveyance Allowance, Book Allowance, Robe Allowance
initialExam.careerGrowth: Civil Judge Class II → Civil Judge Class I → Additional District Judge → District & Sessions Judge → High Court Judge.
initialExam.jobRole: Adjudication of civil suits and criminal cases in Madhya Pradesh subordinate judiciary. Conducting court proceedings, framing issues, recording evidence, and delivering judgments.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit mphc.gov.in 2. Go to Recruitment section 3. Register 4. Fill application form 5. Upload photo & documents 6. Pay fee 7. Submit application

previousYearPapers.topics: CPC, Contract Act, TPA, IPC, CrPC, Evidence Act, Constitutional Law, MP State Laws, Hindi/English
